newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen sluggish, awaiting new cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen sluggish, awaiting new cabinet.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to move sideways on Friday as investors would be reluctant to trade shares ahead of the official announcement of a cabinet reshuffle, brokers said.
"The politics will be a key factor today. Most people are keeping a close eye on the political development today," said one broker at a local brokerage.
The composite SET index finished 4.04 points off at 628.69 on light 2.32 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index fell 0.37 to 47.56.
Local media on Friday said Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh planned to remove two controversial ministers and bring in a well-known businessman and a former finance minister.

They quoted coalition sources as saying former finance minister Virabongse Ramangkura and telecom tycoon Thaksin Shinawatra were expected to become deputy prime minister in chare of economi affairs and commerce minister, respectively.
The official announcement of new cabinet is expected to be made later today, the media said.
